verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is driven programmatically through its own documented protocol libraries: Rust and TypeScript, plus FFI bindings for several other languages. Moq-net/@moq/net carry control channels, and a community production integration (SageOx) built programmatic publishers and subscribers against the relay. There is no evidence of a management or admin API for the relay itself, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: documented relay management/control API, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), API reference depth beyond library index listings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Libraries for Rust (native) and TypeScript (web), plus FFI bindings for C, Python, Kotlin, Swift, Go, and Dart.
Chat, game state, telemetry, and control channels over the same relays with [`moq-net`](/lib/rs/moq-net.html) or [`@moq/net`](/lib/js/net.html).
Browser, desktop, mobile and device clients publish Opus to one relay, which fans out to independent subscribers
